title: Luge Fin And Curved Basket Exhibit Bay
description: One original static sports-equipment exhibit bay, zero new models and one scene. The entire previously accepted contoured-pan luge, wide-fluke twin-pocket monofin and curved catching basket are preserved at original unit scale with every original closed part and opaque PBR value, translated only. Three distinct finite height-varied plinths organize the full equipment forms; a finite floor, rear wall and three blank physical label tabs make an open-front viewing bay with clear foreground aisle. No old object is split, recoloured, resized or counted again as a new prop. All three full original generators and exact whole GLB hashes are embedded and checked before composition. Empty illustrative exhibit only: no wearer, routes/accessibility certification, operating sport, equipment compatibility, plinth load, stability, manufacture or safety capability.
